title.rendered: Arqaam Capital has been appointed by Bahrain Bourse to expand institutional equity research coverage of the Kingdom’s capital market

content.rendered:
Arqaam Capital has been appointed by Bahrain Bourse to expand institutional equity research coverage of the Kingdom’s capital market.

Under the mandate, Arqaam Capital will produce:

• Quarterly coverage of seven listed Bahrain Bourse companies — financial analysis, valuation, investment rationale, and analyst recommendations

• A flagship #Bahrain country report covering the equity market, key sectors, and macroeconomic outlook

Research will be distributed through Bahrain Bourse’s platforms, Arqaam Capital’s research distribution, and key global investor channels.

Independent research is the foundation of credible markets. We are proud to bring our regional sector depth, institutional coverage standards, and global distribution to Bahrain — and to support the work of putting the Kingdom’s listed companies in front of the investors best positioned to deploy capital behind them.

Our thanks to Sheikh Khalifa bin Ebrahim Al-Khalifa and the Bahrain Bourse team for the partnership.
